verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official MCP server that connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation and managing projects. A probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page, and the pricing page lists MCP access even on the solo/free tier. Missing for 10: setup, transport and authentication details for connecting an agent, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
